t: How to Buy a House at Auction | Zillow
s: April 23, 2025 - Not all housing auctions operate the same way; some guarantee a sale to the highest bidder, while others set minimum price requirements or allow sellers to reject bids. How bids are placed at an auction can significantly impact your buying approach. An auction with an open bid allows you to see and react to competitors’ offers, while an auction with a blind bid keeps all amounts hidden until the sale is final.
